stage: C is selected as base outfit; Runecrown is selected as addon1. New addon2 standard concept awaiting graphic approval.

research.scope_note: All 48 enabled Rookhaven server-defined outfit variants, male/female base/full addons and gait frames. Installed official Tibia appearances scanned; all 394 two-layer four-direction figures rendered, including NPC/special variants. These are not claimed to be 394 player outfit families.

visual_findings: Premium/full-addon outfits often get their readable identity from a strong hat/helmet/head silhouette plus a few coherent equipment masses.
Native forearms, cuffs and the two exposed hands must read as connected limbs; pixel-position guards alone do not prevent an accessory or light cloth shape looking like an extra arm.
Cool steel/cloth cuffs keep outfit materials distinct from peach skin. Decorative silhouette changes belong primarily around headgear; avoid dangling pale strips near the arms.
A plain recolored shirt is insufficient as the central selling point; reference craft includes layered materials, deliberate clusters and upper-left highlights.
approval_scope: Choose a clothing/art direction first. These are not completed rotation/walk sheets and are not approved for game import. The chosen design must retain the native Tibia poses, get all directions and walk phases, final four-color masks and editable source.
integration: No outfit IDs, DAT/SPR mutation, server rights, shop data, deployment or native game rendering.
